title: My light is still shining
subtitle: I wanted a place where I could not only write about my childhood trauma, but also write about my spiritual beliefs and also my everyday thoughts and thoughts about the world, I am a empath, a introvert and I love anything spiritual, I love reading about these topics too, so please comment with your blog link if you blog too, under any of those topics. Trigger warning, I will be writing posts on abuse and eating disorders from time to time.
